text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Yasuda Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Oh, here they come!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby...-san really is full of grace!
She was amazing in the Takamatsunomiya Kinen too, so I think I'm backing her today~

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: "No, no! Bamboo Memory takes it by a landslide!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: "She's won the Yasuda Kinen before, so purely in terms of ability, she's definitely number one!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah, Helios... yeah.
That girl is just totally chaotic.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Well... for now it's Bamboo Memory,
and then... Daiichi Ruby-san, I guess?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, isn't it kind of quiet?
Weren't there a few more people at the Takamatsunomiya Kinen?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I thought so too! Well, as a spectator,
it's nicer than being packed like sardines, though.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(As expected, the attention is fading.
—...Do I need further countermeasures?)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (For example—)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
'Sup, Ruby!
Looking forward to working with you today!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I've heard about your reputation.
Sounds like you've got some pretty incredible legs on ya.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: It's an honor to compete with you!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: The pleasure is mine. It is a true honor to be able to run alongside someone of your caliber, Bamboo-san.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...If I am able to triumph over you,
my standing on this path will truly be unshakeable."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Heeh?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Is that a declaration of war?
You're pretty fired up, huh?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Please, interpret it
however you like.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hold on a secec~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Looks like you guys're having a blast!! Count me in too~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ojo's rival is me!
It's totally me!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Right? ♪

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...Please interpret it
however you like."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Is this salt?!
Or like... a tiny pinch of sugar?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Btw, did it totally click with ya!?
Running with me got you totally hyped, didn't it!?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Right!?
I'll raise those vibes today too—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, honestly, isn't that destructiveness insane!?
Whoaaaaaa~~~~!! It's burning hot!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna be the biggest party animal today
and dash right past the lady~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Right before heading to the race, Daiichi Ruby's
aura felt somewhat different than usual.
Normally unreadable, right now she seemed rather—"
choice_data_list: How are you feeling right now?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...If you produce results against today's lineup,
you'll be able to draw even more attention."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I was pondering various other things as well.
However... it was merely a mood.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...That sense of duty that was always there,
telling me I had to win, is now..."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
That is still the sole principle behind my actions.
However... yes, it is changing...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I have to win...
No, I *want* to win...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Ahead of everyone else—faster than anyone else. I want to be the one crossing the finish line...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —That is how “I” must be.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby stared straight ahead.
In her eyes, an unmistakable fighting spirit seemed to surge toward the upcoming race.
choice_data_list: Your speed is what makes it possible.
Your speed is what will make that possible.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I agree.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Following this proud bloodline—
toward a dazzling victory.
